This closes the governance transition without changing protected sources, runtime behavior, narration, voice, audio, captions, avatar media, provider access, credentials, deployment, release, or Cut 1 readiness.

media, deployment, release, production-readiness, or Cut 1 completion claims

invariants: Only the final protected-source hash for each exact path is accepted.
Old, swapped, cross-file, arbitrary, unreadable, and non-byte evidence fails closed.
The exact base, branch, six owned paths, per-path caps, and aggregate cap are enforced.
Protected sources, context bindings, runtime, workflows, dependencies, and private evidence remain unchanged.
Repository status records only the completed governance transition and no Cut 1 product advance.
